rationale: Task T3 requires comparing volume, paid amounts, denial rate and fraud-flag rate across provider specialties and network status, then ranking the top 10 rendering providers by claim count. The plan uses load_tables to ingest the input data, group_comparison with composite provider_specialty+network_status grouping to compute cross-tabulated metrics addressing the network management question about where money and denials flow across specialty and network dimensions, provider_ranking to identify the 10 most active rendering providers by claim volume with their directory attributes, and write_report to synthesize findings into a comprehensive report. All four required metrics are computed; all specified outputs are produced.
changes_summary: Updated write_report component to address transparency concerns raised in self-review: (1) Added 'synthetic_data' caveat to disclosure section, ensuring network management has proper context that data is synthetic for interpreting findings appropriately; (2) Set show_denominators to true so denial and fraud rates display as numerator/denominator pairs (e.g., '115/1000' instead of '0.115'), increasing transparency for network management decisions about denial patterns across provider specialties and network status.
